goals.title: Achieve Complete Financial Independence
goals.description: Reach 150,000+ ETB monthly recurring income across software development, Suku marketplace, and freelancing, while maintaining emergency savings and supporting family.
goals.reason: Build long-term security, eliminate money stress, provide abundantly for my family, and gain sovereign control of my time.
goals.completion_criteria: Sustainable net cashflow of 150,000 ETB/mo with 6 months emergency savings (180,000 ETB).

goals.title: Land First 3 High-Value Software Clients
goals.description: Package full-stack Next.js/React development services, build live portfolio with case studies, and secure 3 paid clients.
goals.reason: Generate immediate supplementary income beyond the 30,000 ETB salary.
goals.completion_criteria: Sign contracts for 3 freelance projects totaling at least 90,000 ETB in client revenue.

goals.title: Launch Suku Ethiopian Marketplace MVP
goals.description: Complete vendor onboarding, product listing catalogue, secure checkout flow, and initial Addis Ababa merchant pilot.
goals.reason: Create an enduring digital commerce platform for local Ethiopian merchants and customers.
goals.completion_criteria: Production deployment with 20 active merchants, 100 listed products, and zero critical security flaws.

goals.title: Master ICT Methodology & Complete 100 Demo Backtests
goals.description: Backtest MSS, Order Blocks, and Silver Bullet on EURUSD & GBPUSD with strict 1:2+ R:R, logging all trades without risking real capital.
goals.reason: Build proven psychological discipline and mechanical consistency before risking real money or taking prop challenges.
goals.completion_criteria: 100 logged backtest/demo trades with positive expectancy, maximum 3% drawdown, and 100% adherence to risk rules.

goals.title: 30-Day Unbroken Morning & Night Prayer Consistency
goals.description: Protect 04:00 AM morning prayer and 21:15 PM night prayer as sacred, non-negotiable appointments.
goals.reason: Spiritual groundedness and gratitude are the bedrock of my peace, discipline, and purpose in life.
goals.completion_criteria: Complete both 30-min prayer sessions 60 days consecutively with recorded reflections.

goals.title: Establish Emergency Reserve (90,000 ETB)
goals.description: Disciplined allocation of salary and freelance proceeds to build an untouchable emergency cushion.
goals.reason: Break the cycle of zero savings and establish financial peace of mind.
goals.completion_criteria: 15,000 ETB verified balance in designated emergency savings account.
